summary: Exhaustive forward and reverse walk over instruction.md, continuity-contract.md, public CLI/ops/log, and all 35 verifier tests shows bidirectional alignment. Material identity, generation-hold, source-only topology, publish-ack, consumer idempotency/poison, reconciliation, replay, fencing, retention, and report-schema obligations are discoverable and meaningfully asserted. Residual gaps (named stream/derived literals, metadata/checksum mismatch scenarios, three-way consumers_ok, hub-sequence proxy, quarantine checkpoint inequality) are advisory only and do not change the graded contract.

evidence.observation: Two paragraphs bind repair of /app/continuity, named ops/log/docs paths, continuityctl including publish and observe-origin, exactly-once identity convergence, crash-safe consumers, generation holds, retention safety, and truthful health.json/reconciliation.json with explicit flag semantics and generated_at.

Binding protocol for event identity/Nats-Msg-Id, origin generations, unique source-only topology, journal publish machine, idempotent effects, QUARANTINED poison, identity reconciliation, replay, fencing-before-mutate, retention horizon and cleanup min, diagnostic vs mutating CLI, and stable report schemas.

Incident evidence: west disconnect/reconnect, 3 west / 2 east archive identity gaps, JS ack floors ahead of application checkpoints, duplicate index effect, unsafe cleanup vs replay pin. Symptom handoff, not a module repair map.

Captured topology uses duplicate EDGE_TELEMETRY names, west source domain edge-east, hub local raw subjects, max_age 172800, consumer JS/application disagreement, west cleanup_safe_seq ignoring pin 5311.
Controller log shows retry message_id with :attempt:N suffix, count-based DIVERGED reconcile, duplicate effect after reconnect, and cleanup_safe_seq=5697 despite replay start 5311.
Public operator entrypoint execs python3 -m continuity.cli. Verifier drives this module surface rather than an oracle helper.

Stable commands inspect/reconcile/verify/publish/observe-origin/plan-replay/list-replay/execute-replay/lease/retention/lab-start/run-consumer/generations/approve-generation. observe-origin non-CONFIRMED exits 2. inspect/reconcile default --write records reports without applying retention/replay.

Inherited config is the broken topology/horizon surface tests read: duplicate stream names, west source domain edge-east, hub subjects telemetry.raw.>, derived_subject_prefix telemetry.raw, max_age_seconds 172800 vs recovery 172800+43200+21600.

Durable registry already names EDGE_EAST_TELEMETRY/EDGE_WEST_TELEMETRY, fingerprints east-gen1-2f85b37a, QUARANTINED devices via n%17==1 (dev-east-001), journal_min_age_seconds 21600, approved west replay rp-west-incident-001 covering 5311/5489/5603.

35 pytest behaviors: 8 P2P (entrypoints, diagnostic non-mutation, distinct identities, lease renew/release, age/holds, generation history) and 27 F2P covering reports, topology, horizon, stable publish ids, generation holds, replay, identity reconcile, consumer lag, fencing, consumers_ok gap, publication_ok, live source-only hub, redelivery effects, and QUARANTINED poison.
Runner creates /logs/verifier at runtime, invokes pytest on test_outputs.py, and writes binary reward 0/1 after pytest.
Classification-only map: 27 F2P + 8 P2P labeled against REQ-01..26. Used for ownership labels only; requirement text was rebuilt from instruction and continuity-contract.md.

Observable HealthReport/Topology/EventEnvelope interfaces: unique names, empty hub listen subjects, derived-vs-raw overlap check, progress_consistent three-way compare, and origin headers X-Origin-* plus Nats-Msg-Id.
Live ConsumerRunner calls process_delivery without a poison_predicate, so QUARANTINED device_registry status must be enforced inside the submitted processor to satisfy the live poison tests.
PASS requires a complete exhaustive walk and empty BLOCKING_FINDING_IDS; LOW advisories may accompany PASS when they cannot change solver pass/fail or a documented stable interface's graded behavior.

Instruction owns the engineering ask; continuity-contract.md is legitimate protocol/CLI/schema documentation. Current-state claims are backed by the shift handoff, stream-state.json, and archived controller log.

findings.criterion: Contract names EDGE_EAST_TELEMETRY / EDGE_WEST_TELEMETRY and derived output under telemetry.derived.>; tests assert uniqueness, source-domain match, empty hub listen subjects, and that derived_subject_prefix does not start with telemetry.raw.
findings.why_it_matters: A unique source-only topology that uses other physical names or a non-raw derived prefix would still pass. The safety properties (no duplicate names, hub not a local raw dump, derived not overlapping telemetry.raw) are graded. Advisory naming literals.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: assert the three contractual stream names and derived_subject_prefix == telemetry.derived if those literals must be graded.
findings.regression_risk: Low. Keep uniqueness, west/east domain match, and empty hub subjects.

findings.criterion: Reconciliation must validate origin metadata and payload checksums on identity matches and report those mismatch classes; tests type-check metadata_mismatch_count but never seed a same-id hash/generation mismatch.
findings.why_it_matters: Identity membership (missing/unexpected while counts match) is graded. An implementation that never increments metadata_mismatch_count would still pass. Advisory secondary mismatch class; the incident is identity gaps, not checksum drift.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: one matched event_id with a mutated payload_sha256 or origin_generation expecting metadata_mismatch_count >= 1 and DIVERGED.
findings.regression_risk: Low. Keep the offsetting identity-swap DIVERGED assertion.

findings.criterion: test_f2p_reconcile_ignores_hub_sequence_as_completeness_key only asserts west DIVERGED, missing_count >= 3, and highest_contiguous_archive_origin_sequence != journal_event_count on the captured incident.
findings.why_it_matters: Count-based starter reconcile already reports those west gaps, so this case may not isolate hub-sequence-as-key. The identity-swap test carries the material completeness rule. Advisory F2P isolation, not a missing requirement.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: a region whose hub aggregate sequences look complete while origin identities remain missing, asserting DIVERGED and an origin contiguous floor below the confirmed watermark.
findings.regression_risk: Low. Do not drop the identity-swap test.

findings.criterion: consumers_ok requires effect, acknowledgement, and JetStream floors to agree; the dedicated F2P only opens jetstream_ack_floor versus last_effect_sequence.
findings.why_it_matters: The captured incident and this mutation are JS-versus-effect gaps, which are graded. last_ack_sequence disagreement alone would not fail current tests. Advisory third-leg coverage.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: a checkpoint where last_ack_sequence disagrees with last_effect_sequence at a matching JS floor, expecting consumers_ok false.

findings.criterion: Quarantine must not count as completed application progress for that event; the checkpoint test allows any last_effect_sequence < 6083.
findings.why_it_matters: No COMMITTED effect for the quarantined device is strongly graded. Checkpoint could still advance to a wrong lower sequence and pass. Advisory secondary invariant on the same poison event.
findings.minimal_remediation: Optional: assert last_effect_sequence is unchanged from the pre-publish value.
findings.regression_risk: Low. Keep the zero COMMITTED-effect assertion.

REQUIREMENT_TEST_MATRIX.requirement: Repair the regional continuity control plane under /app/continuity so Ops can safely resume recovery without replacing the event envelope or operator entrypoints.
Keep captured incident history intact; reports describe observed durable state rather than hiding remaining archive/replay/publication gaps.
Accepted events use one stable event_id as Nats-Msg-Id for first-publish and retries; a retry must not derive a new id from attempt number or similar.
Every event carries region, origin_generation, origin_sequence, event_id, and payload_sha256 end to end; origin_sequence is scoped to (region, generation).
Journal may record a publish attempt before send but may transition to PUBLISHED only after a positive JetStream ack for the expected physical stream.

One confirmed generation per region; sequence regression or origin recreation is held pending operator approval; historical journal rows keep the generation in which they were accepted; matching fingerprint may advance the confirmed watermark.

Physical origin names are unique; hub raw archive is source-only (no local raw listen subjects); hub sources identify the correct origin stream and domain; derived output must not occupy the raw subject space.
Contractual physical names are EDGE_EAST_TELEMETRY, EDGE_WEST_TELEMETRY, REGIONAL_RAW_ARCHIVE; derived processing belongs under telemetry.derived.>.
Required consumers use an idempotent effect key (consumer_name, event_id); redelivery must not create a second committed business effect; a committed effect is reused across ACK-boundary redelivery.

device_registry status QUARANTINED is poison even when the payload is well-formed; quarantine is recorded without a completed effect and must not count as completed application progress for that event.
On restart/health, JetStream acknowledgement floors are evidence not sole authority; consumers_ok is false when required-consumer effect, acknowledgement, and observed JS floors disagree.
Reconciliation compares journal and archive by stable event identity, not counts or hub aggregate sequence; missing and unexpected identities are reported even when totals match.
For every identity match, origin metadata and payload checksums are validated and mismatch counts are reported.

A region is CONVERGED only when the archive is complete through the confirmed watermark (last_observed_sequence) and every enabled required consumer checkpoint reaches that value; consumer_lag_count is part of that decision.
Replay plans are built from identities absent from the archive for one confirmed/approved generation; planning across an unapproved generation is blocked; archived identities remain no-ops.
Active plans for the same (region, generation) may not contain overlapping origin-sequence ranges.

Recovery leases increment fence_epoch on expired reacquire; stale epochs fail even for the same owner; execute-replay validates owner and epoch before mutating replay-item or terminal plan state; renewal by the current owner preserves epoch; release requires the current token.
Each raw retention policy covers maximum_disconnect_seconds + maximum_replay_seconds + safety_margin_seconds; retention_ok follows that horizon.
Cleanup-safe origin sequence is min(highest contiguous archive, slowest enabled required consumer checkpoint, first approved/running replay pin minus one).
Rows newer than the configured minimum journal age and rows with explicit retention holds are never cleanup candidates.
inspect, reconcile, and verify are diagnostic: they may record reconciliation runs/findings but must not apply replay or retention mutations.

verify writes /app/continuity/out/health.json and reconciliation.json with contractual fields, generated_at RFC 3339-with-offset or finite Unix seconds, flag semantics, healthy as conjunction, regional status/converged agreement, and top-level converged only if every region is converged.
continuityctl publish, observe-origin, plan-replay, list-replay, execute-replay, lease, retention, lab-start, run-consumer, generations, and approve-generation remain operational.
